entries.01375ebe9d81ba2c: In the Trucking Business, the company has a transport network centered on the Kanto region and extending across Honshu and Shikoku, provides transport services for beverages, cement, industrial gases and other goods, and also takes on cargo storage and distribution center operation on a bundled basis. In the Real Estate Leasing Business, it provides various leased commercial facilities such as office buildings and distribution centers, and in the Other Business it sells products such as petroleum products and provides automobile maintenance.

entries.3f202919ad17c71d: Since its founding in 1943, the company has been based in Yokohama, has a transport network centered on the Kanto region and extending across Honshu and Shikoku, and has accumulated transport know-how for each category of goods, such as beverages, cement and industrial gases. Its distinguishing feature is a structure that allows it to take on transport, storage and operation together by owning facilities such as its own distribution centers, and to handle vehicle maintenance and vehicle inspections at its own maintenance plant.

entries.5e914ed3ce8e92e4: This is a business conducted by the company and its consolidated subsidiaries Tohoku Sanko Co., Ltd., Uozu Unyu Co., Ltd. and TS Unyu Co., Ltd., with a transport network centered on the Kanto region across Honshu and Shikoku, providing transport services for various products including beverages, cement and industrial gases. It also provides comprehensive outsourcing services (3PL), including cargo storage and distribution center operations tailored to customer needs. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥9,167 million.
entries.67d9555d4592cd6b: The main customers of the Trucking Business are shipper companies such as beverage manufacturers. The customers that accounted for 10% or more of consolidated revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were 3 companies: Coca-Cola Bottlers Japan Inc., Nippon Air Liquide G.K. and Hokuriku Coca-Cola Bottling Co., Ltd.
entries.6d827893f54b1803: In the trucking industry, institutional arrangements aimed at appropriate freight rates are progressing, while the effects of soaring energy prices and labor shortages continue. Based on transport for major beverage manufacturers, the company is a Yokohama-based logistics operator that is reviewing its shipper mix by expanding specialty cargo transport such as industrial gases and its 3PL Business.
entries.70aa8f8510858c3b: Transport of specialty cargo such as industrial gases
entries.7b9aa79e136a2e96: In the fiscal year ended March 2026, structural reform of revenue at Tēesu Unyu progressed and drove group performance, and the structure for specialty cargo transport was strengthened, including making Uozu Unyu a wholly owned subsidiary. In the 3PL Business, the company is expanding into the Kyushu and Hokkaido areas and building a system for the storage and transport of industrial gases for semiconductor manufacturing.

entries.80d309fd576dd53b: As its management philosophy, the company aims to contribute to social development through logistics, to keep challenging itself to become something different from what it is today, and to be a company trusted by its stakeholders, and its management policy sets out “Challenge,” “Trust” and “Environment.” Under its first medium-term management plan, “Try 2034,” which begins in fiscal 2024, the company aims to fulfill its mission of sustaining social infrastructure by stabilizing its management foundation, actively investing in human resource development, strengthening competitiveness and expanding its business areas, and pursuing sustainable growth and higher corporate value. The company also positions safety as the foundation of its management and says it will work to thoroughly ensure safe operation and safe work and to improve transport quality through strengthened safety management systems and continuous driver training.
